name: claude-codex-quota-mac
description: Claude 額度、Codex 額度與 Google 額度三個 macOS 桌面小工具的合併 repo。
author: michelle0812

scripts.install:all: npm run install:claude && npm run install:codex && npm run install:google
scripts.start:claude: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/claude run start
scripts.start:codex: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/codex run start
scripts.start:google: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/google run start
scripts.test:all: npm run test:claude && npm run test:codex && npm run test:google
scripts.build:all: npm run build:claude && npm run build:codex && npm run build:google
